retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "Hi-Score" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "Hi-Score" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

lives.note: player 1 lives, like the 1UP on screen: the byte is the 1UP itself (Seb's game of 6 November 12:15 against its screenshots: 2 while 1UP=2, 1 at the first death with 1UP=1, 0 with 1UP=0; it read one less since the first Metal Slug's rule was copied, 1.33 test 37); 3 for a moment on the soldier select; cheat database Infinite Lives PL1; 0xFF between two games, read 0 (Seb's capture of 22:24 showed 254 on CONTINUE)

lives_p2.note: player 2 lives, like the 2UP on screen: the byte is the 2UP itself (as player 1's, test 37; cheat database Infinite Lives PL2; 0xFF between two games, read 0)

grenades_out.note: player 1 grenades on screen: one more as a grenade leaves the hand, one less as it blows up, on an enemy or at its second bounce (found in the memory recordings of Seb's games of 6 November 09:14 and 12:15: 1 or 2 right after each bombs decrease, back to 0 within 0.3 to 1.5 s, 0 the rest of the time; the status block interleaves the players, player 1 on the odd RetroAchievements offsets, 0xC341 here; 1.33 test 38)

grenades_out_p2.note: player 2 grenades on screen, the even byte beside player 1's as the bombs (0xC348 / 0xC349), to confirm in a two-player game

weapon.note: player 1 weapon, 0xFF handgun, 0 shotgun, 1 rocket launcher, 2 flamethrower, 3 heavy machine gun, 4 laser (cheat database Select Weapon PL1; Seb's capture of 22:24: 3 with the machine gun)

p1_chr.note: player 1 soldier: 0 Marco, 1 Tarma, 2 Eri, 3 Fio (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Character Selected, address swapped), two bytes before his lives; to confirm in game

p2_chr.note: player 2 soldier, same codes (RetroAchievements code notes, P2 - Character Selected), two bytes before his lives

form.note: player 1 body: 0 normal with the handgun, 1 carrying a weapon, 2 fat, 3 mummy (cheat database Select Body Type PL1, RetroAchievements P1 - Forms)

form_p2.note: player 2 body, same codes (cheat database Select Body Type PL2)

prisoners.note: player 1 prisoners rescued in the mission (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Prisoners (Mission), address swapped); to confirm in game

prisoners_p2.note: player 2 prisoners rescued in the mission (RetroAchievements code notes, P2 - Prisoners (Mission), address swapped)

vehicle.note: player 1 in a vehicle (1) or on foot (0): bit 0 (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Riding a Vehicle, address swapped), the first word of his vehicle block 0x10E880..0x10E8A3; to confirm in game

vehicle_kind.note: player 1 vehicle: 1 Metal Slug (tank), 2 Camel Slug, 3 Slugnoid (the mech, 'Mecha SV' in the notes), 4 Slug Flyer (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Last Vehicle Used, address swapped), the last byte of his vehicle block; kept after he leaves it; to confirm in game

vehicle_hp.note: energy of player 1's vehicle in % (full at 0x30 as in Metal Slug; cheat database Infinite Vehicle Energy PL1), shown while he is in it; the camel has no armour

vehicle_ammo.note: cannon shells of player 1's vehicle (cheat database Infinite Vehicle Cannon PL1 writes 10), shown while he is in it

vehicle_p2.note: player 2 in a vehicle, deduced: his vehicle block is 0x24 further (energy and cannon of the cheat database are 0x10E8BF and 0x10E8C5)

vehicle_kind_p2.note: player 2 vehicle, same codes, deduced (0x24 further)

vehicle_hp_p2.note: energy of player 2's vehicle in % (cheat database Infinite Vehicle Energy PL2)

vehicle_ammo_p2.note: cannon shells of player 2's vehicle (cheat database Infinite Vehicle Cannon PL2)

_veh1.note: probe (1.33 test 21): player 1's vehicle block as it is, to confirm the riding bit and the kind from a capture

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

mission.note: mission number, 0-based in RAM (cheat database "Select starting mission"), to be confirmed in game, missions 1 to 6: another value is not read (Metal Slug read 183 while it booted)

p1_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 1 stick and buttons (P1CURRENT): 0x04 left, 0x08 right, 0x10 A. Fires the handgun and scrolls the HD backdrop, to be confirmed in game

p2_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 2 stick and buttons (P2CURRENT), same bits

_hps.note: the lives of the game's objects (1.33 test 36, from Seb's memory recording of 6 November 09:14 with its screenshots): a table of 168-byte entries, the life word 58 bytes after a multiple of 168 from the base; The Keesi II came with 3000 in one entry and its two pods with 1000 each, the big enemies hold 200 to 480, the soldiers 10 to 100; an empty entry holds 0 (the RetroAchievements note 'Entity left wing hp' at 0x10269A is one entry of it)

end_ptr.note: the game's state routine (1.33 test 36, Seb's recording of 09:14 against his screenshots): 63188 while playing, 62696 on the RECAPTURED PRISONER tally, 62764 while MISSION n COMPLETE is written on the screen, 62798 on the fade, 62380 on the mission start screen, 8522 on the title

hd.note: where the bosses' lives are: the whole table of objects (_hps). The entry filled with the life the mission's boss starts with (boss_life, from Seb's recording: The Keesi II 3000) is the boss, named after the mission; in a mission not listed yet, a life of boss_min or more; any other life of 200 or more is a big enemy with a quiet bar (the pods of The Keesi II, 1000 each). mission_done (the game's state routine on its MISSION COMPLETE screen) shows MISSION COMPLETE
